entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: A weatherworker who destroyed the Clan Tree of Cridhe seeking to become a planeswalker, bringing a curse on his family.

entities.name: Haen
entities.description: Keeper of the Clan Tree and Nohr's former friend; Aylith's father.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: A marooned Sangrazul and Nohr's mentor who later serves Nazir as an apothecary.

entities.name: Tempé
entities.description: A planeswalker, Malvos's old mistress.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Haen's daughter, a gifted but untried mage who becomes Keeper and heals the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Cruel Felonarch of Nohr, cursed with madness, who kidnaps Aylith.

entities.name: RoNal
entities.description: Nohrish soldier who captures Aylith and is later sacrificed to the frog; Lorris's father.

entities.name: Lorris
entities.description: RoNal's warrior daughter who allies with Aylith.

entities.name: Jedhian
entities.description: Aylith's cousin, a shepherd who tries to rescue her.

entities.name: Thix
entities.description: Unruly kinsman of the Felonarch killed by RoNal after attacking Aylith.

entities.name: Feryar
entities.description: An elf who takes owl form and aids Aylith.

entities.name: Arn
entities.description: A young slave of Nazir who joins Lorris and Aylith's cause.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: The sword Nohr used to destroy the Clan Tree; later used on Aylith and Malvos.

entities.name: Clan Tree
entities.description: A magic oak through which runs the mana for the entire plane.

entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: The plane whose isle is plunged into generations of winter and darkness.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: Nohrish homeland.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: Homeland of the Keeper.

entities.name: Loch Prith
entities.description: The subterranean paradise of the elves.

entities.name: Mirkalbion
entities.description: Mutated people addicted to ardré fungus who die in sunlight.

entities.name: Far clans
entities.description: Small independent Nohrish hamlets who shun the Felonarch's rule.

entities.name: The Parting
entities.description: The destruction of the Clan Tree that split Cridhe and brought the curse.

entities.name: Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: The healing of the Clan Tree that restores balance.

events.summary: Nohr confronts Haen and destroys the Clan Tree with Soulslayer, breaking the sword tip into his own chest.
events.quote: When Haen refuses to reveal the mana line, Nohr lashes out at the tree with the sword, sending out a freezing beam that causes the Clan Tree to explode into icy chunks.

events.summary: Haen awakes and performs the awakening ritual, bringing spring to his lands.
events.quote: For several weeks there is no end to the winter until Haen finally awakes.

events.summary: Nohrish soldiers raid Inys Haen to capture the Keeper and Aylith.
events.quote: 519 years after the Parting, the destruction of the Clan Tree, Nohrish soldiers descended from the mountains, and launch a raid on Inys Haen

events.summary: Thix starts fires and attacks Aylith; the Keeper and his wife die and RoNal kills Thix.
events.quote: The Keeper and his wife die in the fire and RoNal is forced to kill Thix.

events.summary: Jedhian buries Aylith's mother with a discarded sword that is Soulslayer.
events.quote: which turns out to be the centuries-lost sword Soulslayer.

events.summary: Aylith is nearly devoured by a shroud on the march.
events.quote: On the march to Inys Nohr, Aylith is nearly devoured by a shroud

events.summary: Nazir disguised as a servant compels Aylith to reveal she holds the Memories of the Clan Tree.
events.quote: She is enchanted by Nazir, still disguised as a servant, and is magically compelled to reveal to him the truth about her abilities as Keeper

events.summary: RoNal is lashed and thrown into the dungeon pit, where he sacrifices himself to the frog to save Jedhian.
events.quote: RoNal sacrifices himself to the beast, hoping Jedhian will survive and help his daughter Lorris escape

events.summary: Rebellion erupts; Nazir runs Aylith through with Soulslayer and Feryar carries her away.
events.quote: She tries to form a protective wall with her magic but the enraged Felonarch runs her through with Soulslayer—right above the heart.

events.summary: Nazir and Malvos secretly depart to strike Inys Haen.
events.quote: Fearing the rebellion, Nazir and Malvos take their best forces and secretly depart Inys Nohr to strike Inys Haen

events.summary: Aylith heals in Loch Prith and overcomes her hatred.
events.quote: She journeys into herself and confronts her hate as an immense fiery pit with a horrible bitteroot vine at its heart and is finally able to overcome it.

events.summary: Malvos uses Soulslayer and is bitten by its silver snakes; Jedhian heals him at the cost of the sword crumbling.
events.quote: His snake tattoos and the silver snakes worked into the sword's hilt to come to life and bite him.

events.summary: Aylith heals Nazir's madness; they recite the ritual and the Clan Tree is mended.
events.quote: A small sapling Clan Tree arises and the plane's balance is restored.

events.summary: Malvos is consumed by a shroud disguised as a tent after Tempé visits him.
events.quote: which lulls him to sleep with a magical song and then collapses upon him, consuming him.

relations.quote: They hope to capture the Keeper and his young daughter Aylith
Malvos has entered into his service as an apothecary
RoNal is forced to kill Thix.
the enraged Felonarch runs her through with Soulslayer
Aylith's cousin, a shepherd named Jedhian
She leaves him with a smirk, as the tent is a hungry shroud in disguise
